resources.string: With your permission, the game sends usage statistics (which screens you open, how your casts and battles go, what you buy) and crash reports to Google Firebase. They help us fix bugs and balance the game.
They\'re linked to a random ID, never to your name, and never used for ads. Nothing is sent unless you allow it, and you can change your mind at any time in Settings, under Privacy.
How the game is played: screens, casts, battles, purchases.
What went wrong when the game crashes or something fails.
Usage statistics and crash reports go to Google Firebase, linked to a random ID (never your name), and only if you allow them. They\'re never used for ads.
This version of the game doesn\'t send any statistics or crash reports. Your choices are kept for versions that do.
Your online account (player ID, cloud backup, gifts waiting) is kept on the game server. Deleting it erases all of that; the progress on this phone stays.

This erases everything the game server keeps for you: your player ID, your cloud backup and gifts waiting for you. Your recovery code stops working, and this can\'t be undone.\n\nYour progress on this phone stays, and your purchases stay with your Google Play account. A Captain\'s Club subscription isn\'t cancelled: manage it in Google Play.
The statistics kept on this phone were cleared, and you have a new random ID.
Your online account was deleted. Your progress on this phone is still here, and the game now uses a new player ID.
